rows.what_the_ink_shows: The sum after the square root has a definite dark superscript mark above and to the right of rho, distinct from the dotted subscript i. The superscript has a short hooked top followed by a descending stroke and rounded terminal. Unlike the clear 2 in the immediately preceding uu* sum, it does not visibly have a broad lower return/foot. At this resolution the superscript can be read as a compressed 2 or a 1; I cannot settle the digit from the strokes. The full scan and all four listed contrast-enhanced crops were visually inspected, including a direct comparison with the preceding clear 2. Crops: crops/1_scan056_L1190_equations.jpg, crops/1_scan056_L1190_radical_coefficient.jpg, crops/1_scan056_L1190_exponent_left.jpg, crops/1_scan056_L1190_exponent_right.jpg.
rows.note: The original definite superscript 2 is made explicitly doubtful as 2|1; the visible raised ink is not silently removed. The supplied table proposes the unsquared coefficient rho_i and calls the discrepancy a pen or reading slip, but this review does not establish its mathematical claim. The summation-index uncertainty already in the page is preserved unchanged. The main reader also inspected the raised mark and its comparison digit; the small hooked stroke remains ambiguous between 2 and 1, so the explicit doubt is retained.
rows.event_type: used and rechecked in this run
rows.event_outcome: Compared the original coefficient with the actual scan and four enhanced crops. Confirmed the existence of a raised ink mark but could not conclusively identify it as 2 rather than 1; proposed an explicit uncertainty instead of a definite removal or correction. No mathematical proof check was performed.

additional_events.event_type: carried as background without fault found
additional_events.event_outcome: The supplied table L1190 proposes sqrt(uu*) = sum rho_i bar(b_i) tensor b_i and attributes the squared coefficient to a pen or reading slip. This mathematical refinement was carried with attribution only and not independently checked.
